versions.content: The Pwm module shall comply with the following scaling scheme for the duty cycle:  0x0000 means 0%.  0x8000 means 100%. 0x8000 gives the highest resolution while allowing 100% duty cycle to be represented with a 16 bit value. As an implementation guide, the following source code example is given: AbsoluteDutyCycle = ((uint32)AbsolutePeriodTime * RelativeDutyCycle) >> 15;
